title: Create E2E Taichi smoke test
objective: Create test_e2e_taichi.py: compile SVK elastic problem → write generated .py → execute under Taichi JIT → compare displacement against handwritten reference (max diff < 1e-10).
implementation_steps: test_elastic_hex8_matches_reference: compile(elastic_problem_ir) → write to tmp_path → import via importlib → allocate fields + newton_solve on 1-element Hex8 → compare vs ref_hex8_elastic output
test_newton_converges_one_iteration: verify linear elastic converges in exactly 1 Newton step
Use ref_hex8_elastic.py::solve_elastic output as ground truth (or load from golden .npz)
Handle Taichi JIT compilation time (may take several seconds)
acceptance_criteria: Generated code compiles and runs under Taichi JIT
Tests pass when run with uv run pytest -m slow

cases: Elastic Hex8: compile -> execute -> displacement matches reference (< 1e-10) [partial - test_codegen.py::TestBehavioralEquivalence imports but does not run solver]
Linear elastic converges in 1 Newton iteration [missing]
